title: Poetic Pebbles overview
content: Poetic Pebbles is Aman's flagship published Android application. It is a poetry-sharing app that lets users write, publish, and explore poems while participating in a community through likes, comments, follows, profiles, and notifications. The app is available on Google Play.

title: Poetic Pebbles features
content: Poetic Pebbles includes authentication, poem publishing, likes and comments, follow and unfollow actions, user profiles, notifications, and an admin approval workflow. AI Search and Assistant is listed as under development.

title: Poetic Pebbles technologies
content: Poetic Pebbles was built with Kotlin, XML, Firebase, and the Android SDK.

title: HireSense AI overview
content: HireSense AI is an AI recruitment analysis tool. It analyses resumes and job descriptions to support candidate shortlisting, question generation, and retrieval workflows.

title: HireSense AI features
content: HireSense AI supports resume and job-description analysis, candidate shortlisting, match scoring, Random Forest classification, technical and behavioural question generation, and RAG-based candidate retrieval.

title: HireSense AI technologies
content: HireSense AI uses Python, Streamlit, scikit-learn, NLP, and Ollama.

title: Kaushik Footprints overview
content: Kaushik Footprints is a full-stack e-commerce application with customer shopping flows and administration tools for inventory management.

title: Kaushik Footprints features
content: Kaushik Footprints includes authentication, admin inventory management, product browsing, checkout, address management, and payment options.

title: Kaushik Footprints technologies
content: Kaushik Footprints was built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

title: Land Bidding Platform overview
content: The Land Bidding Platform is a full-stack MERN web application and property marketplace. It combines land listings, live bidding, chat, and account-management workflows.

title: Land Bidding Platform features
content: The Land Bidding Platform includes user authentication and authorization, an admin dashboard and property management, land and property listing and browsing, property details with images and pricing, real-time land bidding, live bid tracking and history, real-time buyer-seller chat, user profile and account management, search and filtering, and a secure bidding and transaction workflow.

title: Land Bidding Platform technologies
content: The Land Bidding Platform was built with React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
